newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albanian protesters burn Albpetrol headquarters.
newsitem.headline: Albanian protesters burn Albpetrol headquarters.

text.p: Albanian rioters set on fire the headquarters of state-owned oil company Albpetrol in the southern town of Patos on Sunday, an Albpetrol official said.
"The main offices of Albpetrol were burned," the official told Reuters by telephone. He was speaking from the neighbouring town of Fieri, 115 km (80 miles) south of Tirana.

The attack on Albpetrol's offices, which happened on Sunday morning, was the latest escalation in two weeks of disturbances triggered by depositors' fury at the collapse of a nationwide network of pyramid investment schemes.
The Albpetrol official did not say how many people were involved in the incident, nor whether there were any injuries.
In the southern town of Vlore rioters set fire to the town hall on Sunday, imitating similar attacks in nearby towns on Saturday and Friday.
